top_news.dek: Semalith v1.4 is a 184M-parameter DeBERTa-v3-base classifier that performs three-axis safety classification in a single forward pass.
top_news.brief: Designed for financial and agentic environments, Semalith v1.4 handles prompt injection, general harm, and regulatory compliance simultaneously. It achieves state-of-the-art detection performance while being 44x smaller than Llama-Guard-3-8B, making it highly efficient for production guardrail deployment.

top_news.title: Anthropic: Discovering cryptographic weaknesses with Claude
top_news.dek: Anthropic's Claude Mythos Preview has identified new attack vectors against HAWK digital signatures and round-reduced AES.
top_news.brief: Researchers used the Claude Mythos Preview model to autonomously discover cryptographic weaknesses. The findings include a significant vulnerability in the post-quantum HAWK signature scheme and a novel attack method for round-reduced AES. While these represent major research milestones, they do not currently impact production systems.
top_news.image_alt: Abstract visualization of cryptographic algorithm analysis

top_news.title: Taiwan detains Nvidia employee in widening China chip smuggling probe
top_news.dek: Taiwanese authorities have detained an Nvidia employee amid an investigation into illegal AI server exports to China.
top_news.brief: Prosecutors in Taiwan are investigating the alleged unauthorized export of Super Micro AI servers to China. An Nvidia employee has been detained as part of the widening probe into potential violations of export control regulations.

top_news.title: Show HN: Formally verified 3D CSG: Trust 93 lines spec, not 1000 lines AI code
top_news.dek: A new Lean 4 project provides the first formally verified 3D constructive solid geometry (CSG) mesh intersection operation.
top_news.brief: This project offers a verified alternative to AI-generated code for 3D mesh operations. By using a 93-line specification in Lean 4, developers can ensure the correctness of mesh intersections and well-formedness conditions without needing to audit large volumes of generated code.

top_news.title: How AgentCore Gateway supports the MCP 2026-07-28 spec
top_news.dek: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) 2026-07-28 update introduces stateless architecture, governed extensions, and hardened OAuth 2.0 authorization.
top_news.brief: The latest MCP specification marks its largest revision, shifting to a stateless protocol compatible with standard HTTP infrastructure. It adds a governed extensions system and improved enterprise-grade authorization. AWS users can enable these updates on AgentCore Gateway via a single API call.

primary.title: The Orchestrator's Tax
primary.summary: Subagents get justified by time saved and parallel execution, but Rahul Garg explains that's not what matters most. Every token in the orchestrator's context is competing for its attention, and the real value of a subagent is what it keeps out of that context. Subagents should be treated as a tool for protecting the orchestrator's working memory, offloading reasoning it doesn't need to hold onto. Doing this well means giving the orchestrator explicit ground rules for when and how to delegate. more…
